description: This file is a unit test class for the ReadingGoalService in the book project. It contains test cases for the methods of ReadingGoalService, using Mockito to mock dependencies and JUnit for testing. The class verifies behaviors like finding by ID, saving, deleting, and counting reading goals.

classes.name: ReadingGoalServiceTest
classes.description: Unit test class for ReadingGoalService, testing various CRUD operations and exception handling

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the mock repository and service instance before each test

methods.name: findById_throwsNullPointerException_ifIdIsNull
methods.description: Verifies that calling findById with null throws NullPointerException and that the repository's findById is not called

methods.name: canFindByNonNullId
methods.description: Tests that findById with a valid ID calls the repository's findById method

methods.name: canFindAll
methods.description: Verifies that findAll calls the repository's findAll method

methods.name: save_throwsNullPointerException_ifGoalIsNull
methods.description: Ensures that saving null reading goal throws NullPointerException and repository save is not called

methods.name: canSaveNonNullGoal
methods.description: Tests saving a valid ReadingGoal instance

methods.name: canDeleteAll
methods.description: Verifies that deleteAll calls the repository's deleteAll method

methods.name: canCount
methods.description: Verifies that count calls the repository's count method
